paragraphs: Met Éireann has a Status Yellow rain warning for County Waterford today. It started at midnight and ends at 12 noon on Sunday.
The rain can be heavy at times. There may be some flooding. Travel may be difficult, and outdoor events may be affected. A warning for Cork and Kerry ended at 8am.
There is also a gale warning at sea until 6pm on Sunday. It covers the coast from Wexford to Cork, Kerry and up to Mayo. Small boats should stay in port on Sunday and Monday.
Drive slowly and do not drive through flood water. Stay away from the sea and cliffs. More wet and windy weather is coming this week.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局今天對沃特福德郡發布黃色降雨警報。
警報從午夜開始，到星期日中午12點結束。
雨勢有時會很大。
可能會有一些淹水。
交通可能不便，戶外活動也可能受到影響。
科克郡和凱里郡的警報已於早上8點結束。
海上也有強風警報，直到星期日下午6點。
它涵蓋從韋克斯福德到科克、凱里，一直到梅奧的海岸。
小型船隻星期日和星期一應留在港內。
開車要慢，不要開過淹水的地方。
遠離海邊和懸崖。
本週還會有更多風雨天氣。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued a Status Yellow rain warning for County Waterford, which is in force from midnight until 12 noon on Sunday. A similar warning for Cork and Kerry ran from 10pm on Saturday until 8am on Sunday.
Rain will be heavy at times, and it could cause local flooding and difficult travel conditions. Outdoor events in Waterford may also be affected.

At sea, a Status Yellow gale warning is in place from Carnsore Point to Mizen Head to Erris Head until 6pm on Sunday. Winds could reach gale force 8 or strong gale force 9 at times. A small craft warning covers all Irish coasts on Sunday and Monday.

Drivers should slow down, leave more space between cars and never drive through flood water. People should also stay away from cliffs, piers and coastal paths. Met Éireann says the weather will stay unsettled in the coming days, with more rain and wind.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局對沃特福德郡發布黃色降雨警報，生效時間從午夜至星期日中午12點。
科克郡和凱里郡的類似警報從星期六晚上10點持續到星期日早上8點。
雨勢有時會很大，可能造成局部淹水和交通困難。
沃特福德的戶外活動也可能受到影響。
海上方面，從卡恩索角到米曾角再到埃里斯角的黃色強風警報持續到星期日下午6點。
風力有時可能達到8級強風或9級烈風。
小型船隻警報涵蓋星期日和星期一的愛爾蘭所有海岸。
駕駛人應放慢速度、與前車保持更多距離，且絕不要開過淹水路段。
民眾也應遠離懸崖、碼頭和海岸步道。
氣象局表示未來幾天天氣將持續不穩定，會有更多雨和風。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has a Status Yellow rain warning in place for County Waterford, valid from midnight until 12 noon on Sunday. An earlier warning for Cork and Kerry, which ran overnight from 10pm on Saturday, expired at 8am.
Spells of heavy rain are expected to bring localised flooding and difficult travelling conditions, and outdoor events could be disrupted.

Conditions at sea are also poor. A Status Yellow marine gale warning covers coasts from Carnsore Point to Mizen Head to Erris Head until 6pm on Sunday, with winds reaching gale force 8 or strong gale force 9 at times. A small craft warning applies to all Irish coastal waters on both Sunday and Monday.

Motorists are advised to reduce their speed, allow extra stopping distance and avoid driving through floodwater. The public should keep well back from cliff edges, piers and exposed coastal areas. Forecasters say the weather will remain unsettled over the coming days.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局對沃特福德郡發布黃色降雨警報，有效時間從午夜至星期日中午12點。
先前科克郡和凱里郡從星期六晚上10點起持續整夜的警報，已於早上8點解除。
陣陣大雨預計將帶來局部淹水和交通困難，戶外活動也可能受到干擾。
海上狀況也很差。
黃色海上強風警報涵蓋從卡恩索角到米曾角再到埃里斯角的海岸，直到星期日下午6點，風力有時達到8級強風或9級烈風。
小型船隻警報適用於星期日和星期一的所有愛爾蘭沿海水域。
建議駕駛人降低車速、預留更多煞車距離，並避免開過積水。
民眾應遠離懸崖邊緣、碼頭和空曠的沿海地區。
預報員表示未來幾天天氣將持續不穩定。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has a Status Yellow rain warning in force for County Waterford, running from midnight until 12 noon on Sunday. A parallel alert for Cork and Kerry, which took effect at 10pm on Saturday, lapsed at 8am on Sunday.
Bouts of torrential rain threaten localised flooding and treacherous driving conditions, and outdoor fixtures may be disrupted.

The outlook out at sea is equally bleak. A Status Yellow marine gale warning stretches from Carnsore Point to Mizen Head to Erris Head until 6pm on Sunday, with gusts intensifying to gale force 8 or strong gale force 9 at times. A small craft warning remains in effect around the entire coastline on Sunday and Monday.

Motorists are urged to ease off, leave ample braking distance and steer clear of flooded roads. The public should give cliff edges, piers and exposed shorelines a wide berth. Forecasters expect the unsettled spell to persist in the coming days.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局對沃特福德郡發布生效中的黃色降雨警報，從午夜持續到星期日中午12點。
科克郡和凱里郡的類似警報於星期六晚上10點生效，已於早上8點失效。
陣陣傾盆大雨可能造成局部淹水和危險的駕駛狀況，戶外活動也可能受到干擾。
海上的前景同樣嚴峻。
黃色海上強風警報從卡恩索角延伸到米曾角再到埃里斯角，直到星期日下午6點，陣風有時增強到8級強風或9級烈風。
小型船隻警報在星期日和星期一持續適用於整條海岸線。
敦促駕駛人放慢速度、預留充足的煞車距離，並避開淹水道路。
民眾應遠遠避開懸崖邊緣、碼頭和空曠的海岸線。
預報員預計這段不穩定的天氣將在未來幾天持續。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued a Status Yellow rain warning for County Waterford, which remains in effect from midnight until 12 noon on Sunday. A comparable warning for Cork and Kerry, which commenced at 10pm on Saturday, expired at 8am.
Periods of intense rainfall are likely to result in localised flooding and hazardous travelling conditions; consequently, outdoor events may be subject to disruption.

Maritime conditions are similarly adverse. A Status Yellow marine gale warning applies from Carnsore Point to Mizen Head to Erris Head until 6pm on Sunday, with winds potentially reaching gale force 8 or strong gale force 9. In addition, a small craft warning is in operation for all Irish coastal waters on Sunday and Monday.

Motorists are strongly advised to reduce their speed, maintain an increased stopping distance and refrain from entering floodwater. Members of the public should likewise remain at a safe distance from cliff edges, piers and exposed coastal areas. Forecasters anticipate that unsettled conditions will persist in the coming days.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局對沃特福德郡發布黃色降雨警報，生效時間從午夜至星期日中午12點。
科克郡和凱里郡的類似警報於星期六晚上10點開始，已於早上8點到期。
強降雨時段可能導致局部淹水和危險的交通狀況；因此，戶外活動可能受到干擾。
海上狀況同樣不利。
黃色海上強風警報適用於從卡恩索角到米曾角再到埃里斯角的範圍，直到星期日下午6點，風力可能達到8級強風或9級烈風。
此外，星期日和星期一所有愛爾蘭沿海水域都有小型船隻警報。
強烈建議駕駛人降低車速、保持更長的煞車距離，並避免駛入積水。
民眾同樣應與懸崖邊緣、碼頭和空曠的沿海地區保持安全距離。
預報員預計不穩定的天氣將在未來幾天持續。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has a Status Yellow rain warning in place for County Waterford, valid from midnight until 12 noon on Sunday. An earlier warning for Cork and Kerry, which ran overnight from 10pm on Saturday, expired at 8am.
Spells of heavy rain are expected to bring localised flooding and difficult travelling conditions, and outdoor events could be disrupted.

Conditions at sea are also poor. A Status Yellow marine gale warning covers coasts from Carnsore Point to Mizen Head to Erris Head until 6pm on Sunday, with winds reaching gale force 8 or strong gale force 9 at times. A small craft warning applies to all Irish coastal waters on both Sunday and Monday.

Motorists are advised to reduce their speed, allow extra stopping distance and avoid driving through floodwater. The public should keep well back from cliff edges, piers and exposed coastal areas. Forecasters say the weather will remain unsettled over the coming days.
